commercial_screening_questions: Who pays for the core activity?
How many paying users can be served per hour?
What are staffing, reset, maintenance and utility costs?
Can several compatible revenue streams use the same infrastructure?
Which components can open in phases?
What permits, specialists and technical systems are essential?
example_query: Find non-residential experiential complexes with repeatable participatory activities and direct customer revenue; exclude research, museums, towers and unverified area claims.
